capabilities.notes: MiniMax Code Agent Client Protocol (ACP) over ndJSON stdio (`mcode acp`). The protocol version was verified against a real 0.6.12 process: initialize, session/new, session/prompt, session/cancel and session/load all answered on the wire, and agent_message_chunk updates arrived during a live turn. session/prompt blocks until the turn ends and the agent rejects a second concurrent prompt. Steering goes through the mcode/session/steer extension and queued follow-ups through mcode/session/queue/enqueue; both require a build that advertises those extensions and are otherwise reported as unsupported. Against a real 0.6.12 process both were confirmed: a steer sent during an active turn was accepted with mode 'steered' and the agent acted on it, and queue/enqueue returned a queued receipt. Steering outside an active turn is rejected by the agent ('Steering requires an admitted, active ACP prompt Turn'), so a steer sent after the turn ended is not delivered. Permission requests arrive as client-side session/request_permission calls and are surfaced as awaiting_input; the reply must reuse the request id and one of the offered option ids. HS requests bypassPermissions by default (MiniMax Code's native default, matching the explicit full-execution authorization); set HARNESS_SUPERVISOR_MCODE_PERMISSION_MODE=default to opt into Ask, which surfaces approvals as awaiting_input. There is no sandbox: cwd is not a file-isolation boundary.
